repos_data.description: Open-Source Quantum Chemistry – an electronic structure package in C++ driven by Python

TorchANI 2.0 is an open-source library that supports training, development, and research of ANI-style neural network interatomic potentials. It was originally developed and is currently maintained by the Roitberg group.
Apache Mahout - an environment for quickly creating scalable, performant machine learning applications.
Pythonic tool for orchestrating machine-learning/high performance/quantum-computing workflows in heterogeneous compute environments.
PennyLane is an open-source quantum software platform for quantum computing, quantum machine learning, and quantum chemistry. Create meaningful quantum algorithms, from inspiration to implementation.
MCP server for trustworthy chemistry: molecular weights, isotope distributions, and compound name/formula lookup, backed by NIST data and online sources.

repo_meta_data.description: The Massively Parallel Quantum Chemistry program, MPQC, computes properties of atoms and molecules from first principles using the time independent Schrödinger equation.
